messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multi-GPU collective hang detected for job redwood-prod/tp-pipeline-42 on cluster-us-west-2. Error rate spike and RPC timeouts > 60s. paging oncall.
oncall-andy: acked. jumping in — can someone grab the job id + node list?
sara-eng-runtime: job id tp-pipeline-42, pods on node gpu-ephemeral-17 and gpu-ephemeral-18. seeing repeated CUDA Xid 79 in syslog on 17.
mike-eng-sre: adding a couple logs here

```
[ 1143.512345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1143.512400] nccl: NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank failed : Unhandled system error
```

mike-eng-sre: nodemap shows heavy memory pressure on gpu-ephemeral-17 (mem used ~98%).

natalie-ops: @oncall-andy any customer-facing jobs running on that cluster? need impact estimate.
raj-mlinfra: yes — two Dedicated inference lanes were pinned to that pool. There may be latency/timeouts for active requests; embeddings jobs should queue.
elena-support: support portal shows ~12 error reports in the last 5m referencing timeouts for customer-c-42 and c-88.
oncall-andy: ok plan: (1) evacuate workload from gpu-ephemeral-17, (2) restart the runtime container on the node, (3) if NCCL re-establish fails, fallback route to smaller-model variant. executing step 1 now.
sara-eng-runtime: starting graceful drain: `kubectl drain gpu-ephemeral-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — will cordon first.

```
kubectl cordon gpu-ephemeral-17
kubectl drain gpu-ephemeral-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

mike-eng-sre: migration in progress, but some tasks are stuck in rendezvous. I see NCCL communicator ID 0x7f8b stalled.
raj-mlinfra: trying to poke NCCL async error handler: set env `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` on the runtime pod and restart to try graceful abort of hung collectives.
sara-eng-runtime: applied env change on a test replica. logs show `nccl: async error handler triggered, aborting communicator` and tasks recovered.
oncall-andy: good. rolling env change to remaining replicas on 17.
elena-support: posting interim update to customers: "We're actively mitigating a multi-GPU communication issue affecting inference latency in us-west-2. Engineers are rolling a fix and routing to fallback models; we'll update in 30m." Want me to send?
natalie-ops: yes, please. include ETA ~30-45m and note we have partial failover in place.

elena-support: sent.

mike-eng-sre: post-drain we restarted runtime container on gpu-ephemeral-17: `docker restart redwood-runtime-abc123` — dmesg cleared Xid 79 but nvml reports 1 GPU in error state. vendor driver logs show possible thermal/firmware glitch.

```
$ nvidia-smi -q -d ERROR
GPU 0: Error: GPU fell off bus
```

raj-mlinfra: because one GPU is in error, NCCL topologies changed and some TP groups lost rank. I'm kicking a coordinator job to re-establish partial-group mode and move remaining ranks to a different node to restore throughput.
sara-eng-runtime: executing coordinator reassign: `redwoodctl job move --job tp-pipeline-42 --from gpu-ephemeral-17 --to gpu-spot-05` — starting now.
oncall-andy: monitor for training/inference regression. if any dedicated customer requests continue to fail, switch to model-variant fallback via routing policy `fallback:small-model`.

elena-support: Customer c-88 reports degraded responses remained after the initial switchover.

sara-eng-runtime: looking at trace, their requests hit the old replica pinned to the draining node; should be cleared now as pods rebalanced. confirming.
mike-eng-sre: we have an on-the-fly mitigation: enable `REDWOOD_ROUTER_FORCE_FALLBACK=1` for the affected route to push traffic off the multi-gpu path until nodes stabilize.

raj-mlinfra: telemetry shows NCCL errors drop to near-zero after coordinator move. latency for fallback path is up ~120ms but errors decreased.
elena-support: updated customers c-42 and c-88 with post-mitigation note.

oncall-andy: summary for handoff: root cause likely combination of transient GPU firmware/hardware error (Xid79) leading to NCCL communicator failure and pipeline rendezvous stalls. Mitigations applied: cordon+drain node, restart runtime container, set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1, coordinator reassign to rebuild groups, and routed impacted traffic to fallback smaller-model variant. Customer impact: partial increase in latency and short tail errors for dedicated lanes; ~12 reported tickets, all acknowledged. Current status: services stable with fallback; ongoing hardware investigation.

natalie-ops: taking over incident for long-running remediation and vendor support. @oncall-andy handing off.

oncall-andy: handing off to natalie-ops. I'll stay available for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident escalated to owner natalie-ops. tagging postmortem template and retention window.

elena-support: will compile customer timeline and ticket list and drop into the incident doc.

sara-eng-runtime: leaving a note — follow-up actions: run hardware diagnostics on gpu-ephemeral-17, replace GPU if error persists, add node-level NCCL health-check to detect early Xid issues, add test for async error handler on canary traffic.

raj-mlinfra: will open a PR to make `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` the default for multi-GPU inference clusters behind a feature flag.

natalie-ops: noted. creating incident channel and assigning owners for hardware, runtime, and customer comms. ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.
elena-support: ack. closing this slack thread; continuing coordination in #incidents-1768009999 (private).
